title: Close the profile page after signing in from it
summary: Since the last plan (commit `e70b456`), signing in from **You** on a phone now returns you to Today if that's where you were, and leaving the profile page before you finish signing in no longer sends you to Today afterwards. Before this change, a signed-out person who tapped **You** and then signed in was left sitting on their profile page. Now, once sign-in succeeds from the profile page, the profile closes and they go back to the screen they were on before: the Today screen if that's where they were, otherwise the Bible reader. If sign-in is cancelled or fails, the profile page stays open as before.

links.label: Issue 2045: Close the profile page after signing in from it

setup.title: Open the preview in a private window
setup.body: Open the preview link above in a private/incognito window, so you start signed out with nothing saved. Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge all work. If the preview shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload.

setup.title: If the page looks out of date
setup.body: The app caches itself, so it can show an older version. Do a hard refresh: **Ctrl+Shift+R** on Windows, or **Cmd+Shift+R** on Mac.

setup.title: Have an email inbox ready
setup.body: Signing in works by email: you type your email address, Seed Bible emails you a login code, and you type the code in. You need an email inbox you can check during testing. You'll sign in and out several times.

setup.title: Where to find "You" and "Today"
setup.body: On a computer, **You** and **Today** are in the sidebar. On a phone (or a narrow browser window), they're in the bar along the bottom of the screen.

sections.title: Going back after signing in
sections.intro: Signing in from the profile page should take you back to where you were.

tests.title: Signing in from the profile page after coming from Today returns you to Today
tests.why: The first acceptance check in the issue.
steps: Tap **Today** so the Today screen is showing.
Tap **You**. The profile page opens and shows a **Log in** button.
Tap **Log in**.
Enter your email address, tick the box agreeing to the terms, and continue.
Open the email from Seed Bible, type the login code into **Enter login code here**, and tap **Confirm code**.
expected: The sign-in window closes.
The profile page closes and the **Today** screen is showing again.
The address bar no longer contains `profile=open`.

tests.title: Signing in from the profile page after reading returns you to the same chapter
tests.why: The second acceptance check in the issue: back in the reader, on the same tab and chapter.
tests.before: Sign out first: tap **You**, then **Sign out** (or use Settings). Make sure you're signed out before starting.
steps: Go to the Bible reader and open **John 3**.
Scroll partway down the chapter.
Tap **You**.
Tap **Log in** and complete sign-in with the emailed code.
expected: The profile page closes and the reader is showing **John 3** again.
It does **not** jump to the Today screen.

tests.title: With more than one tab open, you come back to the tab you were on
tests.why: The issue asks for the same tab, not only the same chapter. Tabs show on wider screens; skip this test on a phone if you don't see tabs.
steps: In the reader, open a second tab and go to **Psalm 23** in it.
Switch back to the first tab and open **Genesis 1** there.
Tap **You**, then **Log in**, and complete sign-in.
expected: The reader shows the first tab, on **Genesis 1**.
The second tab is still there, on **Psalm 23**.

tests.title: After returning to Today once, a later sign-in from the reader goes to the reader
tests.why: The page remembers where you came from. This checks it doesn't remember an old answer: someone who came from Today last time, but from the reader this time, should end up in the reader.
tests.before: Don't reload the page during this test.
steps: Sign out.
Tap **Today**, then **You**, then sign in. Check you're back on Today.
Sign out again.
Go to the reader and open **Romans 8**.
Tap **You**, then sign in again.
expected: After the second sign-in, the reader is showing **Romans 8**, not the Today screen.

tests.title: Opening the profile from a link and signing in takes you to the reader
tests.why: The third acceptance check: when the profile page was the first thing opened, there's nothing to go back to, so it should land on the reader.
tests.before: Sign out, then close the private window and open a new private window so nothing from earlier is remembered.
steps: Open the preview link, then add `?profile=open` to the end of the address (or `&profile=open` if the address already contains a `?`) and press Enter.
Check that the profile page is showing.
Tap **Log in** and complete sign-in.
expected: The profile page closes and the Bible reader is showing.
The address bar no longer contains `profile=open`.

tests.title: Leaving the profile page before finishing sign-in doesn't send you anywhere afterwards
tests.why: New since commit `e70b456`: finishing sign-in now only closes the profile page if it's still showing. Before, someone who had left the profile page while fetching their code could have Today pop open over whatever they were looking at. If the sign-in window closes as soon as you press Back, mark this test **Skip** and say so in your notes.
tests.before: Use a computer, and be signed out.
steps: Tap **Today**, then **You**.
Tap **Log in**, enter your email address, tick the box agreeing to the terms, and continue.
Leave the sign-in window open and press the browser's **Back** button (or **Alt+Left** on Windows, **Cmd+[** on Mac). The profile page should go away behind the sign-in window.
Note which screen is now showing behind the sign-in window.
Open the email from Seed Bible, type the login code into **Enter login code here**, and tap **Confirm code**.
expected: The sign-in window closes and you're signed in.
The same screen you noted in step 4 is still showing. The profile page doesn't come back, and nothing else (such as Today) opens on top of it.

sections.title: When the profile page should stay open

tests.title: Cancelling sign-in leaves the profile page open
tests.why: The fourth acceptance check in the issue.
steps: Tap **Today**, then **You**.
Tap **Log in**.
Without signing in, close the sign-in window with **Cancel** (or its close button).
expected: The sign-in window closes.
The profile page is still showing, with the **Log in** button.
You are **not** taken back to Today.

tests.title: A wrong login code doesn't close the profile page
tests.why: A failed sign-in should leave you where you are.
steps: Tap **You**, then **Log in**.
Enter your email address and continue.
Type `000000` as the code and tap **Confirm code**.
Then close the sign-in window with **Cancel**.
expected: After the wrong code, the sign-in window shows an error and stays open.
After closing it, the profile page is still showing with the **Log in** button.

tests.title: Opening "You" while signed in still shows your profile
tests.why: The fifth acceptance check: nothing changes for people who are already signed in.
steps: Go to the reader.
Tap **You**.
Wait about 10 seconds without tapping anything.
expected: Your profile page opens and shows your name.
It stays open. It does not close by itself or jump back to the reader.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Signing in from somewhere other than the profile page keeps you where you are
tests.why: The issue says sign-in prompts elsewhere in the app already open over the current screen and should be unchanged.
steps: In the reader, open **John 3**.
Tap a verse and try to bookmark or save it. A sign-in window should appear.
Complete sign-in.
expected: You stay in the reader on **John 3**. The profile page doesn't open.

tests.title: On a phone, signing in from "You" returns you to Today
tests.why: Changed since commit `e70b456`: the code review found that the phone bottom bar's **You** button took you to the reader instead of Today. The new commit is meant to fix that, so this checks the fix.
tests.before: Use a phone, or make the browser window narrow until the bar appears at the bottom. Be signed out.
steps: Tap **Today** in the bottom bar.
Tap **You** in the bottom bar, then **Log in**, and complete sign-in.
expected: The profile page closes and the **Today** screen is showing again, not the reader.
The bottom bar is still there.

notCovered: What the browser Back button does after you've been returned from the profile page. The issue doesn't say what should happen there, so it's not tested here; mention it in your notes if it seems odd.
Opening **Profile** from Settings and signing in takes you to the reader, not back to Settings. The issue only mentions Today and the reader, so this isn't tested; note it if it seems wrong to you.
The new automated tests that check the return logic directly.
